Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Sudden Impact]]: the Grail Knight (Robert Eddison) in ''Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade'' (1989), in the Grail temple at the moment he says "He chose... poorly." after Walter Donovan drinks from a false Grail and crumbles to dust. Cropped to the picture area (the letterbox bars and the clip's watermark removed) and reduced to 1000 by 506 pixels.

Source: a frame at 2:21 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VA7J0KkanzM Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (10/10) Movie CLIP - He Chose Poorly (1989) HD], Movieclips, YouTube (1 June 2016), a clip of the film ''Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade'' (1989), directed by Steven Spielberg, Paramount Pictures and Lucasfilm. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260925195939/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VA7J0KkanzM Internet Archive], 25 September 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced frame from the film, showing the character and the moment whose line the card's lore quotes, the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
